newsitem.title: FINLAND: KESKO CEO SEES EU'S TUKO DECISION IN FEB.
newsitem.headline: KESKO CEO SEES EU'S TUKO DECISION IN FEB.

text.p: Finnish wholesaler and retailer Kesko Oy's CEO Eero Kinnunen said on Monday he expected the European Commission to announce next month at the latest which parts of Tuko Kesko it must sell.

"In February at the latest," Kinnunen told Reuters in reesponse to a question, adding the commission was unlikely to announce its decision in January. He was asked to comment on reports the commission might hand down its ruling this week.
Kesko announced last May it would acquire its rival Tuko, but the EU Commission blocked the merger in November, saying it would damage competition in the daily goods market in Finland.
Preparations for the sale of some parts of Tuko have been made, Kinnunen said, but declined to estimate, which parts the commission EU would rule must be sold.
"I can't estimate," he said. "Everything is somehow covered by a grey curtain."
Asked about potential buyers, Kinnunen said that "there has been both domestic and foreign interest".
